newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berlin plans anti-graffiti and dog mess offensive.
newsitem.headline: Berlin plans anti-graffiti and dog mess offensive.

text.p: Graffiti and dog excrement should soon be a thing of the past in Germany's new capital if a clean-up programme launched on Tuesday by the city's environment ministry is sucessful.

The city has allocated 8 million marks ($4.8 million) just to erase graffiti and it also plans to buy special vacuum cleaners to clean up a daily 40 tonnes of dog excrement, Berlin environment minister Peter Strieder told a news conference.
But Strieder said the law would have to be changed to allow the vacuum cleaners to go into action, because cleaning up was currently the responsibility of the dog owner.
